Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against human pyruvate kinase PKM (CHEMBL1075189). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to filter by target CHEMBL1075189 and organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return columns named compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
